item.title: BOYS BASKETBALL: Wyoming Area remains undefeated in Division 2
item.description: EXETER — As they navigate their way toward the end of the regular season, the Wyoming Area Warriors are taking the approach of controlling what they can control. item.title: HS ROUNDUP: Dallas boys clinch WVC Division 1 basketball title
item.description: The Dallas Mountaineers clinched the Wyoming Valley Conference Division 1 boys basketball championship Friday night. Dallas found itself down by one at halftime, but outscored Hazleton Area by 10 in the third quarter as the Mountaineers picked up a 65-51 victory to lock up the title. The Mountaineers are 10-0 in the league, while Crestwood and Wilkes-Barre Area each have three losses in the division. item.title: AKC tips for introducing your pup to a new baby
item.description: Though preparing your family and home for a baby may seem all-consuming, it’s important that you also prepare your dog for the arrival of a new family member. Especially if this is your first child, your dog may be used to being the center of attention, and it can be difficult for your pup to give up that spot. item.description: Ss. Peter and Paul piggie/holubtsi dinner: Pickup, noon to 4 p.m. Saturday, Jan. 31. Ss. Peter and Paul Ukrainian Greek Catholic Church school hall, 635 N. River St., Wilkes-Barre.
